drafted_from: tool:answer-the-configurations-page row in tool-rows.json, do-work/answer-the-configurations-page.mjs, tools/query-and-change-list-rows/src/configurations.mjs (the list definition) and test/answer-the-configurations-page.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Save my current accounts search as a configuration called Configuration c1 for list:accounts, with the title and owner columns and the search 'Sam', then list my saved configurations." It runs tool:answer-the-configurations-page for each route and tells you what was saved.

lists.label: Saved configurations
lists.holds: Reusable filters, grouping, layouts and other settings: one row per saved configuration, with what it applies to, who made it, the settings it includes and the screen path that opens it.
alike: saved views in a spreadsheet or database app
saved filters in a help desk

instructions: 1. Pour the example saved configurations into the list you keep saved views or filters in (see pour), or let the first save make list:saved-configurations for you.

2. Say what you want done with a saved configuration; your AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run and tool tool:answer-the-configurations-page, with path (/configurations, /configurations/<id> or /configurations/<id>/duplicate), method GET or POST, and query or body as the route takes.

3. Read the answer {status, body}: 200 with the configuration, the list with next_before, or {removed}; 404 configuration_not_found; 409 configuration_conflict when your expected_revision is stale (nothing is written); 400 for a bad limit.
4. Configurations shared with you by link or offer, and the time-bound context, answer 503 configuration_unavailable: record sharing is not reachable from this tool.

worked_examples.title: Save a configuration for the accounts list, then list it
worked_examples.ask: Save my accounts search as Configuration c1 and list my saved configurations for list:accounts.
worked_examples.given: From tools/read-and-edit-the-saved-configurations-others-shared/test/answer-the-configurations-page.test.mjs: the account holds list:accounts (row type accounts, fields title and owner) and no configurations yet; the test's search word is replaced here by Sam.
worked_examples.hands_back: {status: 200, body: {configuration: {id: "record:configuration:c1", label: "Configuration c1", target: "list:accounts", field_ids: ["title", "owner"], aspects: ["search"], owner_name: "You", revision: 1, ...}}}. Three records are kept: list:accounts, list:saved-configurations (made by this first save, row type configuration) and record:configuration:c1. A GET of /configurations with query {target: "list:accounts"} then answers {status: 200, body: {configurations: [that configuration], next_before: null}}; a POST to /configurations/c1 with {label: "Old editor", expected_revision: 0} answers 409 with code configuration_conflict and writes nothing.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
